title: Lament for an Ent
author: {name:sindarin_male}
text:
O fallen tree
O broken bough
Your spirit flees
Away from now

O fallen giant
O mighty one
No longer pliant
{choose:Your life is done/Your bark is dun}

O drying leaves
O empty soul
The forest grieves
On every knoll

O barren roots
O dying tree
Bear no more fruits
Your soul is free
